title: mechanisms/confirm/status_A.tsv, status_B.tsv, status.tsv (T2)
$comment: Written 2026-11-11 by pkg:SHARED. FULL_PREREG 4.3 (confirmation rule), 3 (warning definition); STAGE2 T2.3. One row per catalogue row (53 SILENT + L01-L06 in status.tsv). Columns in this order; readers use header names. class_E1 and class_E2 are SHARED additions (the oracle class under the confirm program's card, so FIX/TASKS_M2 can see order-only drift without parsing notes).

columns.name: programs
columns.description: program files relative to mechanisms/confirm/, ';'-separated, e.g. S01.py;S01_b.py

columns.name: attempts
columns.description: number of honest attempts run (1 or 2)

columns.name: drift_E1
columns.description: value drift E0a~E1 under the confirm card (any of ORDER_DRIFT, DTYPE_DRIFT, VALUE_DRIFT, NO_RESULT); na for NOT_FEASIBLE

columns.name: warn_233_measured
columns.description: E0a emitted a pandas Future/Deprecation/PendingDeprecation warning, section 3 definition

columns.name: warn_233_pilotdef
columns.description: same under the pilot warning definition

columns.name: warn_3x
columns.description: any pandas warning (section 3 definition) on E1 or E2

columns.name: status
columns.description: CONFIRMED needs drift on E1 or E2 (pyarrow-only drift does not count); LOUD_CONFIRMED for L rows

columns.name: note
columns.description: free text, no tabs; required (non-empty) when measured warning status disagrees with the prior, for NOT_REPRODUCED / NOT_FEASIBLE, and for QF5 order-only drift

columns.name: class_E1
columns.description: oracle class E0a~E1 of the attempt that decided the status (NA if not run)
